name: alphabetical-function-cards
goal: Function cards sort by their displayed callable name by default and open through the code link without a duplicate arrow

evidence: Default function ordering follows the callable name displayed in its code. Cards expose one code link, no arrow, and retain branch/commit navigation.

Shared collection tests ordered hidden titles, and viewport card cases required the duplicate arrow. Extend the same collection matrix with conflicting titles/callables and require one keyboard-reachable code link.

1481d2ab: isolated collection/rendering checks fail on hidden-title ordering and duplicate links; all three viewport checks fail with function cards have no arrow. Before images retained in /tmp/harness-alpha-before.
Function cards and sorting share the callable-name selector. Default A–Z and reverse order use that name; the single full-width code link replaces the arrow.
9cdd2300: the unchanged collection and card tests plus desktop/tablet/mobile grid scenarios pass in an isolated snapshot. Failing and passing commits and screenshots are preserved.
